# Moms on Teaching UK

> Online 1-on-1 tutoring for British Indian families across the United Kingdom, covering 11+ Exam Preparation (Verbal Reasoning, Non-Verbal Reasoning, English, Maths), GCSE Tuition (AQA, Edexcel, OCR), A-Level Tuition (Sciences, Maths, Humanities), and Indian Curriculum continuity (CBSE, ICSE, IGCSE), delivered by qualified mother-teachers.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://uk.momsonteaching.com/): Overview of all four programmes and cities covered
- [About](https://uk.momsonteaching.com/about.html): Company story and Mother-Teacher philosophy
- [All Services](https://uk.momsonteaching.com/services.html): 11+ Exam Prep, GCSE, A-Level, and Indian Curriculum programmes
- [11+ Exam Prep](https://uk.momsonteaching.com/services/11-plus-exam-prep.html): Grammar school entrance exam preparation details
- [GCSE Tuition](https://uk.momsonteaching.com/services/gcse-tuition.html): GCSE tutoring details
- [A-Level Tuition](https://uk.momsonteaching.com/services/a-level-tuition.html): A-Level tutoring details
- [Indian Curriculum](https://uk.momsonteaching.com/services/indian-curriculum.html): CBSE, ICSE, and IGCSE tuition details
- [London](https://uk.momsonteaching.com/locations/london.html): London-specific service details
